svg.title: Large-ship routes on the James River stop 22 km short of Richmond; 28 ships reach the end of the routes

cc:Work.dc:title: Large-ship routes on the James River stop 22 km short of Richmond; 28 ships reach the end of the routes
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of the James River route cells shaded by distinct large ships, and a step chart of ships against distance from the entrance; 975 ships at the entrance and 28 at Richmond.
